title: 13. 엉덩이 딱! 밥은 앉아서!
titleT: 13. Bottom Stays Put! Eat Sitting Down!

pages.ko: "엉덩이 딱! 밥은 앉아서!" 엄마가 노래하며 따끈따끈 밥상을 차려요. 호리는 의자에 쏙 앉아 냠냠 준비 완료. 그런데 강아지 두부는 벌써 꼬리를 살랑살랑, 엉덩이가 들썩들썩해요.
pages.t: "Bottom stays put! Eat sitting down!" Mom sings as she sets out a warm, steaming meal. Hori hops right into his chair, ready to eat. But the puppy Dubu is already wagging his tail and wiggling his bottom.

pages.ko: 한 입 먹자마자 두부가 폴짝! 의자에서 내려와 방울 장난감으로 쪼르르 달려가요. "두부야, 아직 밥 먹는 중이잖아!" 호리가 불러도 두부는 딴청, 데굴데굴 장난감만 굴려요.
pages.t: The moment he takes one bite, Dubu hops down! He jumps off his chair and scurries over to his bell toy. "Dubu, you're still eating!" Hori calls, but Dubu pays no attention, just rolling his toy around and around.

pages.ko: 이리저리 돌아다니다 두부는 그만 밥알을 뚝뚝 흘리고 말았어요. 다시 와서 한 입 먹으니 밥은 어느새 차갑게 식어 버렸어요. 맛이 없는지 두부는 시무룩 귀를 축 늘어뜨려요.
pages.t: Wandering here and there, Dubu ends up dropping bits of food all over. When he comes back for another bite, the food has already gone cold. It doesn't taste good, and Dubu droops his ears sadly.

pages.ko: 엄마가 두부를 폭 안아 다시 의자에 앉혀 줬어요. "두부야, 재밌는 놀이 하나 해 볼까? 의자에 자석이 숨어 있대!" 엄마가 두부 엉덩이를 콩 두드리자 두부 귀가 쫑긋, 눈이 동그래졌어요.
pages.t: Mom scooped Dubu up and sat him back in his chair. "Dubu, want to play a fun game? They say there's a magnet hidden in the chair!" When Mom tapped Dubu's bottom, his ears perked up and his eyes went wide.

pages.ko: 엄마가 상상 이야기를 시작하자, 두부 눈앞에 그림이 그려졌어요. 방석 속에 알록달록 꼬마 자석이 숨어서, 엉덩이가 앉으면 "딱!" 하고 붙잡아 준대요. 두부는 눈이 동그래져 꼬리를 살랑살랑 흔들어요.
pages.t: As Mom began her make-believe story, a picture formed before Dubu's eyes. A tiny, colorful magnet is hiding inside the cushion, and when his bottom sits down, it goes "click!" and holds him in place. Dubu's eyes went round and his tail wagged happily.

pages.ko: 호리가 씩 웃으며 규칙을 알려 줬어요. "하나, 의자에 엉덩이 딱! 둘, 두 손 모아 냠냠! 셋, 다 먹고 일어나기!" 호리가 먼저 엉덩이를 방석에 붙이며 "딱!" 시범을 보이자, 두부도 따라 앉아 "딱!" 하고 방석에 붙었어요.
pages.t: Hori grinned and explained the rule. "One, bottom stays put on the chair! Two, hands together, nom nom! Three, get up only after you finish eating!" Hori showed how it's done first, pressing his bottom onto the cushion with a "click!" and Dubu followed, sitting down with a "click!" onto the cushion too.

pages.ko: 방울 공이 데구르르 굴러와도 두부는 엉덩이를 딱 붙인 채 꾹 참았어요. "엉덩이 딱! 밥은 앉아서!" 두 손을 모아 냠냠, 한 입 두 입 골고루. 두부가 처음으로 자리에서 밥을 다 먹었어요.
pages.t: Even when his bell ball came rolling by, Dubu kept his bottom stuck in place and held firm. "Bottom stays put! Eat sitting down!" Paws together, nom nom, bite after bite, all around. For the first time, Dubu finished his whole meal without leaving his seat.

pages.ko: 두부가 빈 그릇을 보며 어깨가 으쓱, 꼬리가 붕붕 돌아가요. 그 순간 옆에서 지켜보던 호리 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 부릉! "두부가 끝까지 앉아서 먹었어! 최고야!"
pages.t: Looking at his empty bowl, Dubu's shoulders puffed up proudly and his tail spun round and round. At that moment, the stripes on Hori's tail, who had been watching beside him, sparkled in rainbow colors—vroom! "Dubu sat and ate the whole thing! Amazing!"

pages.ko: 이제 두부는 밥때 규칙을 알아요. 하나, 의자에 엉덩이 딱! 둘, 두 손 모아 냠냠! 셋, 다 먹고 일어나기! 다음 날 저녁, 밥상이 차려지자 두부가 제일 먼저 의자에 쏙 앉았어요. "엉덩이 딱! 밥은 앉아서!"
pages.t: Now Dubu knows the mealtime rule. One, bottom stays put on the chair! Two, paws together, nom nom! Three, get up only after finishing! The next evening, as soon as the table was set, Dubu was the first one to hop into his chair. "Bottom stays put! Eat sitting down!"

pages.ko: 엄마가 두부를 폭 안고 등을 쓰다듬어 줬어요. "우리 두부, 앉아서 먹으니까 밥이 더 맛있지?" 두부가 엄마 볼을 핥으며 꼬리를 흔들어요. 앉아서 먹으면 밥도 따끈, 마음도 따끈. "엉덩이 딱! 밥은 앉아서!"
pages.t: Mom gave Dubu a big hug and stroked his back. "Our Dubu, doesn't the food taste even better when you eat sitting down?" Dubu licked Mom's cheek and wagged his tail. When you eat sitting down, the food stays warm, and so does your heart. "Bottom stays put! Eat sitting down!"
